test_title: SSC GD Constable (2022) Official Paper (Held On : 09 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Statutory body of higher education, which was set up during the first five year plan in India, ______.

options.text: All India Council of Technical Education

solution:
The correct answer is __**University Grants Commission.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **University Grants Commission (UGC)** came into existence on **28 December 1953** under **the first five-year plan in India** to promote and coordinate university education.
 
• It became** a statutory body** under **University Grants Commission Act 1956.**
 
• It is the main **regulatory body for higher education** in India.
 
• It is responsible for providing recognition to universities in India and disbursing funds to them for development and research purposes.
 
• It sets quality standards for higher education institutions in India and monitors their compliance.
 
• It also provides financial assistance to universities and colleges for the development of infrastructure and research facilities.
 
• In **2018**, UGC was **replaced by the Higher Education Commission of India (HECI)** which will act as a single regulator for higher education institutions in India. However, the proposal is** yet to be implemented.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **National Council for Teacher Education (NCTE)** was established in **1993**.

 
 
• It regulates and coordinates teacher education programs in India.
 
• It is **a statutory body** of the Indian government set up under the **National Council for Teacher Education Act of 1993.**
 
 
 
• The **Medical Council of India(MCI)** was first established in **1934** under the **Indian Medical Council Act, of 1933**.
 
 
• It was later reconstituted as **a statutory body** under the **Indian Medical Council Act, 1956** which replaced the earlier Act.
 
• It was **regulating medical education and profession** in India.
 
• It was for establishing uniform and high standards of medical education in India until its dissolution **on 25 September 2020** when it was **replaced by the National Medical Commission(NMC)**
 
 
 
• The **All India Council of Technical Education (AICTE)** was established in **1945 **as a national-level apex advisory body to conduct a survey on the facilities available for technical education and to promote development in the country in a coordinated and integrated manner.
 
 
• It is responsible for **regulating and coordinating technical education** in India.
 
• It became **a statutory body** under the **All India Council For Technical Education Act 1987**.
